# Speaker Deck

> > Speaker Deck is a presentation sharing platform that lets you upload and share PDF presentations online with privacy controls, custom branding, and embedding options.

Speaker Deck offers both free and Pro subscription tiers for sharing presentations, with Pro features including password protection, private URLs, custom branding, scheduled publishing, and Canvas LMS integration. The platform serves educators, storyboard artists, and professionals who need secure, professional presentation sharing.

## Key Topics

- Speaker Deck Pro
